change_summary: Add only the four preregistered checksum-valid Kraken depth-10 H3 orderbook state features as raw context on XBT/ETH/SOL eligible candidates. No threshold, transform, score weight, pair ranking, model, entry/exit/risk mechanic, extra candidate discovery or active baseline behavior is changed.

evidence_plan.minimum_gate: >=20 eligible matched XBT/ETH/SOL candidates across >=2 distinct UTC dates AND >=95% H3 point-in-time context capture. If <3 baseline-vs-H3 decision divergences occur, classify INCONCLUSIVE_LOW_IMPACT and do not tune or auto-extend.
evidence_plan.cost_model_reference: 0.60% taker per side, same conservative project reference; pilot creates no orders.
evidence_plan.noneligible_pair_behavior: baseline passthrough; not counted toward H3 eligible sample

promotion_gate.rule: Pilot evidence can only proceed to human project review. Any later promotion requires prospective incremental value after costs under a separate preregistered gate and separate release approval; this draft alone cannot promote.
